_doc: Permit and status research for the 20 largest Texas campuses in the DC registry (by IT-eq GW dated 2026-30, pipeline universe, 2026-11-09).

Four research agents read TCEQ / ERCOT / company / press sources per campus; reviewed by Capstone before use. 'campus' = exact registry name. Registry fields changed from it are in overrides.csv with the same date.
Shown in dc-delay-risk.html: double-click Texas -> 'What is missing' column (bold line = this research, grey line = registry flags).

Separately issued: Standard Permit 180320 (Electric Generating Facilities, 2025-06-18; ~613 MW of gas generation per Cutrer Labs, MW not in the TCEQ record) and PBR 180353 (emergency engines, 2025-06-16). Whether phase 1 can run 24/7 under the standard permit alone is not established.

interconnection.detail: No ERCOT large-load filing or utility agreement found; TCEQ filings describe a self-powered data center whose plant does not sell to the grid. Islanded operation would sit outside ERCOT large-load approval and Batch Zero; no source on grid backup.

local.detail: Unincorporated Hill County outside Hubbard city limits (no zoning). Reinvestment zone 2026-02-10 (tax only); Nexus withdrew its abatement request 2026-04-07; the county moratorium of 2026-05-12 exempted projects under construction and was rescinded 2026-06-04.

other_gates.item: Public hearing requested on 183046/PSDTX1700: possible contested-case referral after the freeze
